decisions.reason: Restricting spreadsheet tracking to hosts interested in content does not change the existing HubSpot condition that a lead must be ready to schedule or the use of spreadsheet details.
The source changes which responding hosts are entered into the tracking spreadsheet and gives prospect-selection guidance; it does not change the outreach-message delivery or template requirement.
The source concerns Airbnb prospect tracking, not the spreadsheet used to record ecommerce products.
The reference to hosts moving forward with content describes Airbnb lead qualification and does not alter the Google Drive content-bank artifact.
The instruction not to read reviews applies to selecting Airbnb hosts for outreach, not to CJ Dropshipping product-selection evidence.
The Airbnb spreadsheet inclusion rule neither resumes nor changes the deferred HubSpot contact-property configuration requirement.
Airbnb interested-prospect tracking does not change daily social scheduling, publishing activities, cadence, or account context.
The source concerns Airbnb host outreach and prospect tracking, not Shopify product publication.
The source does not change any TikTok Shop product-listing rule or field behavior.
The Airbnb lead-tracking decision is unrelated to Pinterest competitor research or its required links.
The source does not alter temporary or final Shopify product categorization.
